about: Every initial-condition source hex can start from, as table rows. One path serves all of them: acquire the declared products, write one WPS intermediate through met_intermediate with the row's Vtable and map-source label, build the init through the source-agnostic init door with the row's first-guess declarations. A new source is a row here plus, when its parameter codes are new, a Vtable; no per-source code exists or may be added (the arbitrary acceptance test, a project ruling).

run_switches.about: Init switches that are properties of the run and mesh, not of the source. Identical for every row so two sources differ only in their meteorology. Every value is the one the shared GFS 30 km case was built with (its init provenance engine_argv).

select.about: The records Vtable.GFS-hydrometeors.rw decodes, by .idx name and level. The WPS intermediate decoded from them is byte-identical to the whole-file decode (measured once on the 2026-10-16 12Z cycle without the hydrometeor rows). CLMR|CLWMR|ICMR|RWMR|SNMR|GRLE on the isobaric levels are the first guess's cloud, ice, rain, snow and graupel (GFS v16 on; CLWMR is the older name): the init door hands them to rw_mpas_init --first-guess-hydrometeors. THE BREAKAGE THEY PREVENT (hex-meshes-sources review, 2026-10-29): the default hex route started from GFS 2023-03-31 12Z with no condensate at all.
